concepts.lead: The RGPH-3 is an exhaustive census: it covers everyone residing in Djiboutian territory on the reference date, regardless of nationality, across the country's six administrative regions.
concepts.referencesText: National Statistics Institute of Djibouti (INSTAD), General Population and Housing Census (RGPH-3), 2024.

population.def: All persons whose usual place of residence is within the territory at the time of the census, including foreign residents.

menage.def: A group of people, related or not, who usually live in the same dwelling and share at least one meal in common.

activite.def: Share of the active population (employed or unemployed) within the total population aged 15 and over.

chomage.def: Share of people without a job and available to take one within the active population, including discouraged workers who did not actively seek employment.

alphabetisation.def: Share of people aged 10 and over able to read and write a simple text in at least one language.

pauvrete.def: A poverty measure combining several simultaneous deprivations (education, health, living conditions), beyond monetary income alone.
